goal: Configure Sol for design architecture and PR review and Terra for implementation of clear specifications

in_scope: Set project parent Sol for design and orchestration; default bounded implementation subagents Terra. Add explicit Sol workflow/architecture designer and PR reviewer profiles and a Terra specification implementer profile.
Set lesson author to Terra, technical reviewer to Sol; retain appropriate other named review/research models and record role-based routing and runtime limits.
Add configuration regression coverage and update workflow documentation.
out_of_scope: No lesson or curriculum work, no changes to the current course-outline task, no publication or merge.

constraints: User request: Sol for workflow design, architecture and PR review; Terra for implementation when specification is clear.
Preserve review gates, source coverage, provider-specific profile boundaries, and ongoing task files.
No claim of measured token or cost savings; actual session settings and host role overrides may prevail.

definition_of_done.text: Profiles, routing guidance and regression tests implement requested assignments without changing task gates.
Required checks run and exact results recorded.

acceptance_criteria.text: Sol design, architecture and PR reviewer; Terra clear-spec implementer and lesson author; parent Sol; default subagent Terra; technical reviewer Sol.
Independent checks validate TOML, role assignments, full tests, content and task state; no ongoing course files altered.
